findings.title: Container without readiness probe
findings.description: A container without a readinessProbe receives traffic before it is ready, causing failed requests during startup. Define a readiness probe.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Container image without digest pin
findings.description: A container image without an @digest pin (e.g. image@sha256:...) can change under its tag: the tag may be moved to a different image. Pin images by digest for reproducible, verifiable deployments.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Kubernetes security best practices and the CIS Kubernetes Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
